title: Scan Codes
description: Explicitly maintained check code per storage_point (the code printed on the location label and scanned by the operator to confirm the location). There is no generation rule: the list is maintained by hand or written by an external script (e.g. from the label printing system). A storage_point without an entry has no scan code. The file is optional and imported from warehouse.yaml like any other structure file.

storage_point.description: Compiled storage_point id ('<storage_type_id>.<coordinate>', or the id of a work_center / reporting_point flagged storage_point_ref).

code.description: Check code as scanned. Printable ASCII without spaces, 1-64 characters. Must be unique within the warehouse.
